About Zeke’s Landing & Marina
Zeke’s Landing and Marina sits just across the street from some of the most beautiful beaches in the country. A mere 10-minute boat ride from the Gulf of Mexico. Zeke’s boasts a long history of excellence in the charter fishing industry and proudly hosts the largest charter fleet on the Gulf.
For your next saltwater fishing adventure, consider Zeke’s Marina. We offer the largest charter fleet on Alabama’s Gulf Coast, providing the perfect trip for every angler, regardless of experience level.
Additionally, we offer a variety of dry dock options. Our commitment extends to providing premier customer service and adopting an environmentally friendly approach to operating a marina.

 About Us

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 

 

 

 

 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 Zeke’s Landing and Marina sit just across the street from some of the most beautiful beaches in the country. A mere 10-minute boat ride will take you from here to the Gulf of Mexico. Zeke’s boasts a long history of excellence in the charter fishing industry and proudly hosts the largest charter fleet on the Gulf. Additionally, we offer a variety of dry dock options. Our commitment extends to providing premier customer service and adopting an environmentally friendly approach to operating a marina. We are open seven days a week, with exceptions only for Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Year’s Day, to ensure we can support your boating and fishing needs.
For your next saltwater fishing adventure, consider Zeke’s Marina. We offer the largest charter fleet on Alabama’s Gulf Coast, providing the perfect trip for every angler, regardless of experience level. Our family-friendly charter office is always ready to assist you in finding the right boat and captain to meet your needs.
Zeke’s offers everything from inshore fishing in the back bays to exciting excursions targeting billfish and yellowfin tuna over 70 miles offshore. Among the most-requested types of fishing is offshore bottom-fishing, which remains excellent year-round. These charters target a variety of species including snapper, grouper, amberjack, triggerfish, king mackerel, and the seasonal cobia. Booking your next fishing trip is convenient, whether over the phone, through our website, or in person. With over 50 professional charter boats on standby, Zeke’s charter fleet remains the standard in saltwater fishing on the northeastern Gulf Coast. Look no further; your offshore adventure starts here!

 

 
 
 

 

 
 

 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 Zeke’s has it all …

 Experience an unforgettable summer adventure on this boat cruise!
Looking for something fun and unique to do this summer? Hop aboard the Zeke’s Tiki Queen for a memorable cruise on our serene back bays. We offer a range of cruises that guarantee relaxation and enjoyment on the stunning waters of Orange Beach. Let our experienced Captain and crew guide you as we search for dolphins, manatees, and coastal birds, showcasing the natural beauty of our beautiful islands.
Whether you’re interested in a shared bay cruise, a private bay cruise, a sunset cruise, or a private sunset cruise, we have the perfect option for you. The Zeke’s Tiki Queen comfortably accommodates up to 18 passengers, with prices starting at $50 per person. For a more exclusive experience, we offer private excursions starting at $500 for the first 10 people.
Feel free to bring your own drinks and food to enjoy during your cruise. For added convenience, we have a fantastic restaurant connected to our marina that offers to-go food and drinks. Additionally, our dock store is stocked with a variety of beverages and snacks to ensure you have everything you need for a great time on the water.
Join us to unwind with your drink of choice, enjoy great tunes, and create lasting memories with your favorite people. Our goal is to provide you with an escape filled with beautiful sights, tropical vibes, and plenty of photo opportunities. Come and see why we love Orange Beach—your adventure awaits on the water!

 Experience great party boat fishing in Orange Beach!
Anyone with a passion for saltwater fishing knows the feeling of excitement, relaxation, and joy that spending a day on the water can bring. When embarking into the beautiful Gulf of Mexico, the last thing that should be on any angler’s mind is the cost of their excursion. That’s why we offer Shared Expense trips and our party boat, Zeke’s Lady, which allow you to fully enjoy your trip without having to foot the entire bill.
Our shared expense deep sea fishing trips carry between 6 and 15 people (20 and 36 hour trips carry a maximum of 10 people). We offer six  different excursion lengths – 6, 8, 10, 12, 20 and 36 hours – with prices ranging from $250 to $1000 per person. In addition, groups with 4 or fewer people are encouraged to fish with other small groups to alleviate the cost. We cannot guarantee the exact amount of people as we take reservations up until the night before, but it will be a max of 15 (10 for 20 or 36 hour trips).

We also ask that all guests show their appreciation to our hardworking crew with a customary deckhand tip of 18-20% of the price of the charter.

 Please Note
 
 

 
 
Trips that do not meet the minimum capacity will be canceled
Fish do have a season, size and creel limits. All trips include license, bait and tackle. Please bring your own ice chest with food and drink. No glass containers are allowed on boats or docks. Your deckhand works for tips and fish cleaning only. Please tip 20% of the cost of your fishing trip. They will gladly filet your fish for $.30 per pound whole weight.
If you would like to be on a boat with just your group, we offer Private Charters.
All boats have different rates and availability

Only the Captain can cancel the trip for weather. He/she will do so the morning of the scheduled trip.

Cancellations may be made by our office as late as the night before.
Trip departure times may vary and depend on the individual captain. Morning trips typically depart between 5:00AM and 7:00AM, afternoon trips typically depart between 12:00PM and 2:00PM. You will be contacted prior to you trip with exact departure time.

 Orange Beach Party Boat Fishing for the Whole Family!
Zeke’s Lady is a 65-foot Bonner. The boat is available for daily walk-on trips (6 hours), private trips (up to 8 hours) and cruises. We fish primarily offshore south of the beach on the Gulf of Mexico. We specialize in bottom fishing for Vermillion and Red Snapper.
Everything needed for a guaranteed good time is provided. That includes, bait, tackle, rods and reels, and fishing licenses, all on the best shared charter in Orange Beach. Our informative and helpful agents in the charter office will provide departure and return times for your charter. Food and beverages are not provided by the boat. However, our Dock Store does carry drinks and sandwiches along with other snack items. Please do not bring glass bottles on your charter. Costs not included in the initial charter price are fish cleaning (30 cents per pound), customary deckhand tip (18%-20% of the charter) and a fuel surcharge on certain trips. Rubber-soled shoes are beneficial for fishing.

Any cancellations made less than 21 days in advance will forfeit the deposit unless the trip can be rescheduled and ran one time only on the same boat within 90 days of the original booking date.
Any cancellations made less than 72 hours in advance will forfeit both the trip and the deposit. In case of inclement weather only the captain can cancel for weather. If he/she does so, they have up until the morning of to cancel.
If that should happen you would have the option of rescheduling or receiving your money back.

FOR PER-PERSON RESERVATIONS ON ZEKE’S LADY/ PARTY FISHING

Only the Captain can cancel the trip for weather. He/she will do so the morning of the scheduled trip.

Captain Alex is a third-generation charter captain who’s been fishing out of Orange Beach since he was 10 years old, with 16 years at the helm. He specializes in creating unforgettable trips for families and serious anglers alike, offering everything from 6-hour charters to multi-day adventures—including bottom fishing for snapper, grouper, amberjack and triggerfish, offshore trolling for tuna, wahoo, marlin and mahi, plus swordfishing, shark fishing, and nearshore trolling. Captain Alex is known for going the extra mile and takes pride in running a trip rooted in faith—often starting the day with a quick prayer before heading out.
